items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He was a good E-flat man. ... He played with them all.

ctx.x: He was a good E-flat man. To whom? Good E-flat clarinet player? Yeah. He was a good E-flat man. Who did he play with on E-flat? He played with them all. He played with the...
Onward. And he played with the Tuxi, the band's drum.
